'''Agata Shrine''' (縣神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Ōamishirasato|en|Ōamishirasato|qid=Q1203251|lt=Ōamishirasato, Chiba}}, formerly part of {{ill|Sanbu District|en|Sanbu District|qid=Q1153740|lt=Sanbu District, Chiba}}, in {{ill|Kazusa Province|en|Kazusa Province|qid=Q1055394|lt=Kazusa Province}}. The former shrine Rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|en|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines}} was that of a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}{{efn|Former shrine rank|lt=Son-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917284|qq= 近代社格制度|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 近代社格制度}}.
== Deities ==
The shrine enshrines:
* {{ill|Amaterasu|ja|大日孁尊|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q455602|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q455602|comment=changed title based on wikidata}} (Ōhirume-no-Mikoto),
* {{ill|Tachibanahime-no-Mikoto|ja|橘比賣命}} (Tachibanahime-no-Mikoto),
* {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|en|Emperor Ōjin|qid=Q317997|lt=Emperor Ōjin}} as {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|ja|譽田別命|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 応神天皇|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 応神天皇|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q317997}}.
== History ==
Although the exact date of the shrine's founding is unknown, tradition holds that it was served by the local {{ill|Agatanushi|ja|縣主}}, an ancient regional administrative officer, during the reign of Emperor Seimu (the 13th emperor of Japan). 
Later, in {{ill|1488|en|1488|qid=Q4853|lt=1488}} (Chōkyō 2), when {{ill|Sakai Sadataka|ja|酒井定隆|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11644072}} rebuilt {{ill|Toke Castle|ja|土気城|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11423717}}, the shrine was constructed at this location in the northeast as a spiritual barrier against evil ({{ill|kimon|ja|鬼門}}). Since then, it has been revered as the guardian shrine of the Sakai clan.
During the rule of the Tokugawa shogunate, starting from {{ill|1591|en|1591|qid=Q6766|lt=1591}} with {{ill|Tokugawa Ieyasu|en|Tokugawa Ieyasu|qid=Q171977|lt=Tokugawa Ieyasu}}, the shrine was granted five koku of red seal land ({{ill|shuinchi|ja|御朱印領}}), making it the only shrine in Sanbu District to receive such patronage from the Tokugawa clan.
Although the shrine was destroyed by a wildfire in {{ill|1816|en|1816|qid=Q6953|lt=1816}}, it was rebuilt in {{ill|1843|ab|1843|af|1843|als|1843|am|1843 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1843|ar|1843|ary|1843|arz|1843|ast|1843|av|1843 сон|avk|1843|az|1843|azb|۱۸۴۳ (میلادی)|ba|1843 йыл|ban|1843|bar|1843|bat_smg|1843|bcl|1843|be|1843|be_x_old|1843|bg|1843|bn|১৮৪৩|bpy|মারি ১৮৪৩|br|1843|bs|1843.|ca|1843|cdo|1843 nièng|ce|1843 шо|ceb|1843|ckb|١٨٤٣|crh|1843|cs|1843|csb|1843|cv|1843|cy|1843|da|1843|de|1843|diq|1843|el|1843|eml|1843|eo|1843|es|1843|et|1843|eu|1843|fa|۱۸۴۳|fi|1843|fiu_vro|1843|fo|1843|fr|1843|frp|1843|frr|1843|fur|1843|fy|1843|ga|1843|gan|1843年|gcr|1843|gd|1843|gl|1843|gv|1843|he|1843|hi|१८४३|hif|1843|hr|1843.|hsb|1843|ht|1843 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1843|hy|1843|hyw|1843 թուական|ia|1843|id|1843|ilo|1843|io|1843|is|1843|it|1843|ja|1843年|jv|1843|ka|1843|kaa|1843|kk|1843 жыл|kn|೧೮೪೩|ko|1843년|krc|1843 джыл|kv|1843-ӧд во|la|1843|lb|1843|lez|1843 йис|li|1843|lij|1843|lld|1843|lmo|1843|lt|1843 m.|lv|1843. gads|mai|१८४३|map_bms|1843|mdf|1843|mg|1843|mhr|1843|mi|1843|min|1843|mk|1843|mr|इ.स. १८४३|mrj|1843 и|ms|1843|my|၁၈၄၃|myv|1843 ие|mzn|۱۸۴۳|nah|1843|nap|1843|nds|1843|nds_nl|1843|new|ई सं १८४३|nl|1843|nn|1843|no|1843|nrm|1843|nso|1843|oc|1843|olo|1843|or|୧୮୪୩|os|1843-æм аз|pl|1843|pnb|1843|pt|1843|qu|1843|ro|1843|ru|1843 год|rue|1843|sah|1843|scn|1843|sd|1843ع|se|1843|sh|1843.|shn|1843|si|1843|simple|1843|sk|1843|sl|1843|smn|1843|sq|1843|sr|1843|stq|1843|su|1843|sv|1843|sw|1843|szl|1843|ta|1843|te|1843|tg|Соли 1843|th|พ.ศ. 2386|tk|1843|tl|1843|tly|1843|tpi|1843|tr|1843|tt|1843 ел|uk|1843|ur|1843ء|uz|1843|vec|1843|vi|1843|vls|1843|vo|1843|wa|1843|war|1843|xmf|1843|yi|1843|za|1843 nienz|zea|1843|zh|1843年|zh_min_nan|1843 nî|zh_yue|1843年|qid=Q7629|lt=1843}}. In {{ill|1978|en|1978|qid=Q2483|lt=Showa 53}}, it was designated as a model shrine by Chiba Prefecture.
The great cedar tree (Ōsugi) of Agata Shrine is designated as a {{ill|Natural monument|en|Natural monument|qid=Q23790|lt=Natural Monument of Japan}} by Ōamishirasato City. The shrine's address, Toke Tobichi 1876, reflects its history as an {{ill|Enclave and exclave|en|Enclave and exclave|qid=Q15621274|lt=enclave}} of the former Toke Town (now part of {{ill|Midori-ku, Chiba|en|Midori-ku, Chiba|qid=Q926492|lt=Midori-ku, Chiba}}).

== Access ==
Take a bus bound for {{ill|Kimi-no-Mori|ja|季美の森|qid=Q140447332}} from {{ill|Ōami Station|en|Ōami Station|qid=Q5353488|lt=Ōami Station}} on the {{ill|Sotobō Line|en|Sotobō Line|qid=Q670656|lt=Sotobō Line}}. Get off at "Kimi-no-Mori Entrance" and walk for 6 minutes.
